title: You can defeat the Dream Devourer from Chrono Trigger using an int overflow
summary: This article documents a clever exploit in the classic SNES RPG Chrono Trigger where players can defeat the notoriously difficult Dream Devourer boss by intentionally triggering an integer overflow in the game's damage calculation system, causing the boss to die instantly or become vulnerable.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of defeating the Dream Devourer boss through unconventional means rather than standard combat strategies.
why_valuable: It demonstrates how understanding low-level programming vulnerabilities can be applied creatively in gaming contexts, serving as both entertainment and an educational example of integer overflow exploitation.
